faq.q: What is the price of plots for sale in Vandalur?
faq.a: Plots typically start from around ₹3,700–₹4,800 per sq.ft. for basic residential layouts, with premium gated-community and CMDA-approved schemes going up to ₹6,000–₹8,000+ per sq.ft.

faq.q: What is the plot appreciation rate in Vandalur?
faq.a: Land rates have appreciated at an average of about 8–9% per year over the last 12 months, with stronger long-term growth of roughly 25–30% over the past five years.

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying land in Vandalur?
faq.a: In Tamil Nadu, stamp duty for land in Vandalur is generally 7% of the market or guideline value, with an additional 4% registration fee.

faq.q: Can I buy a plot in Vandalur on EMI?
faq.a: Yes — many developers offer 'no-interest EMI' or low-interest installment schemes for plots in Vandalur, allowing payment in easy monthly installments.

faq.q: Is investing in plots in Vandalur a good long-term decision?
faq.a: Yes — investing in plots in Vandalur is widely regarded as a strong long-term decision due to steadily rising land values, improving infrastructure, and proximity to major employment hubs.

faq.q: Are plots in Vandalur CMDA or DTCP approved?
faq.a: Most reputable layouts in Vandalur offer plots that are either CMDA or DTCP approved, ensuring legal clarity and smoother bank loan approvals.

faq.q: What documents should I check before buying a plot in Vandalur?
faq.a: Always verify the original sale deed, latest patta, encumbrance certificate, and the seller's latest registered sale documents.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy plots in Vandalur?
faq.a: Yes — NRIs can buy plots in Vandalur, provided the layout is approved and the title is clear.

faq.q: What are the popular localities to buy plots near Vandalur?
faq.a: Kolapakkam, Guduvanchery, and parts of the GST Road corridor offer easy access to Vandalur while providing slightly softer land rates.

faq.q: Is Vandalur a good place to buy a plot?
faq.a: Yes — Vandalur is an excellent place to buy a plot thanks to its strategic location between Chennai and Chengalpattu and improving road infrastructure.
